docs.title: Research Assistant Documentation
docs.text:
This documentation site describes a local, document-aware assistant built to make internal knowledge searchable and usable without relying on external SaaS tools. The project combines a Streamlit interface, a Chroma-based vector index, and a document ingestion pipeline to let users ask questions over their own documents and receive grounded, source-backed answers.

It is designed for individuals who need a practical, privacy-conscious way to retrieve information from large document collections while keeping the workflow local and controllable.

docs.title: What this project solves
docs.text:
• Makes private documentation searchable
  • Reduces time spent manually browsing large document sets
  • Provides source-backed answers instead of generic AI responses

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: This document explains how to install the application on Windows and macOS.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Windows 10/11 or macOS (Intel / Apple Silicon).
  • Docker Desktop installed and running.
  • Google Drive installed and synchronized locally.
  • A valid OpenAI API key.
  • Internet access for the OpenAI API.

docs.title: Installation steps
docs.text:
1. Copy the project folder to the target machine.
  2. Initialize the environment:
  3. Windows: Run scripts\setup.ps1 via PowerShell.
  4. macOS: Run scripts/setup.sh via Terminal.
  5. Open .env at the project root and fill in:
  6. OPENAI_API_KEY=...
  7. RAW_DIR=... (local absolute path to the synchronized Google Drive folder to index)
  8. Create the quick-launch shortcut:
  9. Windows: Run scripts\create_shortcut.ps1 to add the app to the Start menu.
  10. Launch the application:
  11. Windows: Open the shortcut, or run scripts\launch_app.vbs or make docker-up.
  12. macOS: Run scripts/launch_app.sh or make docker-up.

docs.title: Quick verification
docs.text:
• The application should open in your default web browser (http://localhost:8501).
  • The "Conversation" and "Mise à jour" tabs should appear.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• If the project folder is moved, recreate your shortcut.
  • After a dependency update (pyproject.toml), run make docker-install to rebuild the Docker image.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The application is a local Streamlit UI that queries a locally stored Chroma index. Documents are synchronized via Google Drive and then processed through an update pipeline (conversion, extraction, chunking, and indexing).

docs.title: General organization
docs.text: The application is organized into specialized modules:

docs.title: src/ui/
docs.text:
• app.py — Streamlit interface for the end user.
  • Handles RAG queries, displays results and sources, and manages index updates.

docs.title: src/core/
docs.text:
• rag.py — RAG logic (vector search, ranking, answer generation with citations).
  • update_pipeline.py — Orchestrates the update pipeline by calling the successive steps.
  • registry.py — Manages the document inventory (sources.csv) and related metadata.
  • This is the core business logic of the application.

docs.title: src/pipeline/
docs.text:
• Update pipeline steps called by update_pipeline.py:
  • convert_legacy_office_to_modern.py — Converts .doc/.ppt files to .docx/.pptx.
  • scan_and_extract.py — Scans files and extracts text (PDF, Word, PPT, etc.).
  • chunk_hierarchical.py — Splits documents into hierarchical chunks (leaf + parent).
  • index_chroma.py — Indexes chunks in Chroma with embeddings.

docs.title: src/admin/
docs.text:
• Maintenance utilities:
  • backup_index.py — Exports/restores the Chroma index.
  • reset_local_state.py — Resets all local data.

docs.title: src/query/
docs.text: • rag_answer.py — RAG query tool for the CLI (alternative to the Streamlit UI).

docs.title: src/integrations/
docs.text:
• External services and APIs:
  • llm/openai_utils.py — Wrapper for OpenAI calls (embeddings, generation).
  • vector/chroma_utils.py — Helpers for managing the Chroma index (create, load, delete).

docs.title: src/utils/
docs.text:
• paths.py — Centralized file path constants.
  • logging_utils.py — Log configuration.
  • fs_utils.py, common_utils.py, type_hints.py — General helper modules.

docs.title: Update pipeline (data flow)
docs.text:
Main steps:

  1. Legacy conversion (.doc, .ppt -> .docx, .pptx).
  2. Scan and content extraction.
  3. Hierarchical chunking (leaf + parent).
  4. Chroma indexing.
flowchart TD
    A["Raw files (Google Drive)"] -->|convert_legacy_office_to_modern| B["Modern files (.docx, .pptx, .pdf)"]
    B -->|scan_and_extract| C["Extracted text (JSON)"]
    C -->|chunk_hierarchical| D["Chunks (leaf + parent)"]
    D -->|index_chroma| E["Vector index (Chroma)"]

docs.title: Runtime data
docs.text:
All outputs are isolated in .runtime/ (git-ignored):

  • .runtime/registry/sources.csv — Document inventory.
  • .runtime/data/extracted/ — Extracted text as JSON.
  • .runtime/data/chunks/leaf/ and parent/ — Hierarchically split chunks.
  • .runtime/data/index/chroma/ — Persistent vector index.
  • .runtime/logs/ — Detailed execution logs.
  • .runtime/backups/ — Index backups.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
The .env file at the project root contains:

  • OPENAI_API_KEY: OpenAI API key.
  • RAW_DIR: Local path to the synchronized Google Drive folder.
  • Optional: SOFFICE_PATH: Path to soffice.exe (unnecessary in Docker container).
  • Optional: CONVERTED_DIR to change the conversion output folder.

docs.title: RAG
docs.text:
Default parameters are defined in src/core/rag.py.

Models:

  • Embeddings: text-embedding-3-small
  • Generation: gpt-5-mini

docs.title: Launch and shortcuts
docs.text:
• scripts/setup.ps1 / .sh: initializes the .env file and builds the Docker image.
  • scripts/create_shortcut.ps1: creates an "Assistant documentaire" shortcut in the Windows Start menu.
  • scripts/launch_app.sh: launches the app on macOS.
  • scripts/launch_app.ps1: orchestrates Docker and opens the browser on Windows.
  • scripts/launch_app.vbs: launches the app on Windows (avoids opening a terminal window).

docs.title: Software update
docs.text:
Simple update strategy:

  • Replace the project files with the new version.
  • Rerun make docker-install (or the setup script) to rebuild the Docker image if dependencies changed.
  • Recreate the shortcut if the project folder has changed.

docs.title: Logs
docs.text:
Logs are stored in .runtime/logs/:

  • rag_answer.log: queries and generation.
  • update_pipeline.log: update pipeline execution.
  • scan_and_extract.log, chunk_hierarchical.log, index_chroma.log, convert_legacy_office_to_modern.log.

docs.title: Backup / restore the index
docs.text:
Run: python -m src.admin.backup_index

Export: python -m src.admin.backup_index export Optional: add --zip to create an archive.

Restore: python -m src.admin.backup_index restore --input <path> --yes

docs.title: Local reset (advanced)
docs.text:
Destructive script that deletes local data: python -m src.admin.reset_local_state --yes

Use only if:

  • The index is corrupted.
  • You want to start from a clean local state.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• LibreOffice error: set SOFFICE_PATH in .env.
  • Indexing error: check the OpenAI API key and connectivity.
  • No sources found: verify the scan and chunking steps.

docs.title: Démarrer l'application
docs.text:
• Ouvrir le menu Démarrer.
  • Cliquer sur "Assistant documentaire".

Si le raccourci n'existe pas, demander à l'installateur de le recréer.

docs.title: Écran principal
docs.text:
L'écran principal comporte :

  • Une zone de conversation.
  • Une barre latérale avec les paramètres.

docs.title: Mode de réponse
docs.text:
Deux modes sont disponibles :

  • Recherche: réponse factuelle avec citations.
  • Résumé: réponse synthétique et structurée.

Choisir le mode selon l'objectif de la question.

docs.title: Passages par document
docs.text: Ce réglage évite qu'un seul document domine la réponse. Plus la valeur est haute, plus un même document peut contribuer à la réponse.

docs.title: Filtres
docs.text:
Les filtres permettent de limiter la recherche :

  • Nature (dossier ou catégorie)
  • Type de fichier
  • Nom du fichier

Utiliser "Réinitialiser les filtres" pour revenir à une recherche globale.

docs.title: Poser une question
docs.text:
1. Saisir la question dans la zone de chat.
  2. Valider pour lancer la recherche.
  3. Lire la réponse et consulter les sources si besoin.

docs.title: Voir les sources
docs.text:
Sous chaque réponse, un panneau "Sources" affiche :

  • Le document d'origine.
  • La page ou le paragraphe concerné.

docs.title: Mise à jour de la base documentaire
docs.text:
1. Ouvrir l'onglet "Mise à jour".
  2. Cliquer sur "Mettre à jour".
  3. Confirmer.

La mise à jour peut prendre plusieurs minutes et utiliser des crédits API. Ne pas fermer l'application pendant l'opération.

docs.title: Quitter l'application
docs.text: Utiliser le bouton "Quitter l'application" dans la barre latérale. Fermer le navigateur ne stoppe pas l'application.

docs.title: Bonnes pratiques
docs.text:
• Poser des questions précises.
  • Utiliser les filtres pour réduire le bruit.
  • Mettre à jour la base après ajout de documents.

docs.title: Dépannage rapide
docs.text:
• Message "Je ne trouve pas de passage pertinent" : reformuler la question ou utiliser des filtres.
  • Erreur RAG : vérifier la connexion Internet et la clé API dans .env.
  • Échec de mise à jour : vérifier la synchronisation Google Drive et l'installation de LibreOffice.
